title: 1.3 Related Fields to Physics
description: Related Fields to Physics concepts and applications. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: A scientist explains a chemical bond using atomic physics. Which relationship does this illustrate?
options: Chemistry is rooted in atomic and molecular physics
Chemistry is a branch of biology now in experiments
Physics depends on chemistry only now in this topic
Physics and chemistry are unrelated in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Chemistry is rooted in atomic and molecular physics

questions.question: An architect calculates how a roof carries weight and how sound travels in a hall. Which field is being applied?
A researcher dates a rock layer using radioactivity and maps earthquake waves. Which field is being applied?
A team uses physical laws to model how a cell responds to forces. Which field is being applied?
A team models how seismic waves travel through the Earths interior. Which field is being applied?
A hospital uses an x-ray machine and an ultrasonic blood-flow device. Which field covers both?
Which pair of fields both study the Earth using physics?
Which pair of fields both apply physics to living systems?
A physicist works with engineers on a stable bridge and with geologists on earthquake risk. Which two applications are involved?
Which statement about engineering in the textbook is accurate?
options: Physics is central to structural stability, acoustics, heating and cooling
Engineering avoids all physical calculations in this topic in the textbook
Engineering studies only living organisms now for students in the textbook
Engineering is identical to medical physics in the textbook in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: Physics is central to structural stability, acoustics, heating and cooling

questions.question: Which statement about geology in the textbook is accurate?
options: It uses radioactive dating and earthquake analysis
It uses only microscopic lenses now in experiments
It studies only the atmosphere now in the textbook
It relies on music theory in class in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: It uses radioactive dating and earthquake analysis

questions.question: A scientist studies biological phenomena with physical methods and mathematical laws. Which field is this?
A scientist applies physics to the Earth as a planet and its internal processes. Which field is this?
Which example belongs to medical physics rather than biophysics?
options: Using magnetic resonance imaging for diagnosis
Modeling the motion of a single cell in nature
Studying the physics of bird flight in physics
Analyzing the forces in a muscle in this topic
questions.correctAnswer: Using magnetic resonance imaging for diagnosis

questions.question: Which example belongs to biophysics rather than medical physics?
options: Studying how biological systems obey physical laws
Operating an x-ray scanner as well in the textbook
Planning radiation therapy as well in the textbook
Interpreting an ultrasonic image now in this topic
questions.correctAnswer: Studying how biological systems obey physical laws

questions.question: A chemistry student studies how atoms interact. Which physics area underpins the topic?
An engineer designs lighting, heating and cooling for a library. Which field uses physics this way?
A researcher studies heat transfer across land and ocean surfaces. Which field is being applied?
Which set lists fields that all draw on physics according to the textbook?
options: History, art and literature in physics
Music, dance and drama in the textbook
Law, politics and economics in physics

questions.question: A field applies physics to diagnose illness and another to understand earthquakes. Which pair fits?
options: Engineering and optics in the unit
